The '''silver lined sword''' was a long and straight [[Sword/Legends|blade]] that saw use during the [[Jedi Civil War]]. It sparkled with a silver sheen that became brighter as the hilt was grasped. The blade was warm and appeared to become white-hot when held. A flame insignia was impressed upon the hilt. One of these swords resided in the [[Tomb of Ajunta Pall]].
